report_summary: The report gives a consistently bounded account of responsive answer sharing, lifecycle experiments and reported bypasses. It identifies positive correction as well as false signals, reproduces the48key/420save recurrence result, and explicitly declines claims about labor cost, authenticated identity or measured evaluation effects.
